verdict.rationale: Poly ships its own programmatic surfaces: a scriptable `poly` CLI that can search, read, create, update and organize files, and a live hosted MCP server at mcp.poly.app (search, fetch, and a virtual CLI as tools, OAuth-protected). That covers core file workflows, but nothing shows parity with the UI, and probes found no public OpenAPI/REST spec. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose public API, evidence that sharing, Shared Drives, Flashback/version recovery, journaling, and imports are reachable programmatically, and an explicit UI-parity statement or independent corroboration.
